blocks.text: Water-based sealing and consolidating primer, an aqueous solution of acrylic emulsions, free of organic solvents and bituminous products. It regulates the absorption of the substrate, consolidates it and improves the bonding of subsequent coatings.

items: Low water absorption: forms a surface film.
Aliphatic and UV-resistant.
Non-toxic, non-hazardous and non-flammable under normal handling conditions.

blocks.text: Ready-to-use liquid, dilutable in water according to the porosity of the substrate, for preparing surfaces before applying microcements and other coatings.
Apply on a clean, sound substrate free of dust, grease and loose parts.
Stir before use. Apply with a brush, roller or sprayer in a uniform coat, without puddling.
Depending on the porosity, nature and characteristics of the substrate, as well as the requirements of the finishing product, it can be used neat or diluted 1/1, 1/2 or 1/3 with tap water.
Allow to dry for at least 4 hours before applying the finish.
Approximate coverage: 20 m² per kg for a film thickness of 50 µm, depending on the surface and the dilution.
